notablePrerequisites:
Junktroller does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Junktroller by tapping it, putting any card from your graveyard on the bottom of your library.
Cast Tunnel Vision by paying {5}{U}, naming the card put on the bottom of your library.
Resolve Tunnel Vision, putting all but the bottom card of your library into your graveyard.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.
